requirement: Parse any .avl file into AvlGeometry without error
rationale: avl_fileread is the sole entry point; if it errors the entire pipeline is blocked

requirement: Populate header fields: name, Mach, symmetry flags, Sref/Cref/Bref, CG, CDoref
rationale: Reference quantities are required for normalizing aero coefficients and setting up run cases

requirement: Parse all SURFACE sections and return them keyed by name
rationale: Surface names are used as labels in plots and output tables

requirement: Parse per-section geometry (xle, yle, chord) for each surface
rationale: Section coordinates are required for geometry visualization

requirement: Parse CONTROL entries on each section
rationale: Control names are carried through to the command generator and aero tables

requirement: Parse BODY section when present
rationale: Body data must not halt parsing of real aircraft files that include a fuselage

requirement: Expose ordered control names via AvlGeometry.ctrl_names
rationale: Ordered names map directly to AVL's d1..dN slots in the command script

requirement: Return empty ctrl_names for geometry with no control surfaces
rationale: Wing-only models must not produce phantom control entries or errors

requirement: ctrl_names returns the same sequence on repeated calls
rationale: Sweep code calls ctrl_names multiple times; non-determinism would corrupt Di index assignment

requirement: Parse a single .st file and return exactly one StResult
rationale: One output file per run case; parsing must not split or merge

requirement: StResult.filename matches the source file basename
rationale: Filename is used as a row key in the results DataFrame

requirement: StResult.controls maps d0N indices to surface names as written in the .st header
rationale: Control map is needed to translate d0N keys back to named surfaces in aero_filewrite

requirement: Extract flight-condition scalars: Alpha, Beta, Mach
rationale: Alpha and beta become the table breakpoints in aero_filewrite

requirement: Extract total force coefficients: CLtot, CDtot, CDvis, CYtot, etc.
rationale: These are the primary outputs users build lookup tables from

requirement: Extract stability derivatives: CLa, Cma, Cnb, Cmq, etc.
rationale: Required for flight dynamics modeling and stability margin calculations

requirement: Extract control derivatives: CLdN, CmdN, etc.
rationale: Required for control law design and control authority analysis

requirement: Extract neutral-point location as Xnp
rationale: Common stability metric frequently requested independently of the full coefficient set

requirement: Store spiral stability ratio under key Clb_Cnr_div_Clr_Cnb and not Cnb
rationale: The compound key prevents the ratio from silently overwriting the real Cnb derivative

requirement: Parse all .st files in a directory and return one result per file
rationale: Enables batch processing after a full sweep without requiring individual file paths

requirement: results_to_dataframe returns a pd.DataFrame with one row per StResult
rationale: Provides a pandas interface for downstream analysis and CSV export

requirement: DataFrame columns include filename and every key present in .data
rationale: All parsed fields must be accessible by name for filtering and analysis

requirement: DataFrame cell values match the parsed .data values exactly
rationale: Ensures no silent truncation or type coercion during pivot

requirement: Run block includes separator, case name, and alpha/beta/Di variable assignments
rationale: AVL requires the exact run-case format; missing fields produce silent zero-value substitutions

requirement: Case name encodes the geometry name
rationale: Name appears in AVL output and helps correlate .st files to source geometry

requirement: Alpha and beta are mapped to their respective AVL variables
rationale: Unmapped variables default to zero in AVL silently ignoring sweep inputs

requirement: All named controls are assigned to their respective variables
rationale: Unmapped controls default to zero in AVL silently ignoring requested deflections

requirement: CDoref is written into the run case
rationale: Ensures viscous drag is included consistently across all cases

requirement: CG coordinates (Xref, Yref, Zref) are written into the run case
rationale: Moment coefficients and neutral point depend on the reference CG position

requirement: Unit strings are written when Lunit/Munit/Tunit are provided
rationale: Physical units affect dimensional output quantities

requirement: Geometry with no controls produces a valid run block without control lines
rationale: Wing-only runs must not emit malformed control assignments

requirement: Stdin command script begins with PLOP G (graphics disabled)
rationale: Geometry is loaded via CLI arg; PLOP G must come first to suppress plot windows before OPER

requirement: Graphics are disabled via PLOP followed by G
rationale: Suppresses interactive plot windows that would block AVL in headless or CI environments

requirement: Script opens the OPER menu
rationale: All run execution and output saving commands are issued inside OPER

requirement: Script ends with Quit
rationale: Without Quit the AVL subprocess hangs waiting for further input

requirement: Each run case sets alpha and beta via A A and B B direct assignments
rationale: Direct assignment bypasses AVL trim logic and uses the specified flight condition exactly

requirement: Each run case saves a .st file to out_dir
rationale: Output files are the only persistent artifact of each AVL run

requirement: Each run case executes (i), saves (st), and resets (x then CINI) before the next
rationale: CINI clears accumulated forces; omitting it causes subsequent results to inherit prior state

requirement: Control sweep emits Di Di <defl> commands for each surface and deflection value
rationale: Incorrect Di index or deflection value silently runs a different flight condition

requirement: Multiple alphas produce one run block each
rationale: Batches the full alpha sweep in a single AVL invocation

requirement: find_avl checks ~/bin/avl first
rationale: Allows a local user build to take priority over a system install

requirement: find_avl raises FileNotFoundError with message AVL binary not found when absent from both locations
rationale: Clear error message guides the user to install the binary rather than a cryptic traceback

requirement: find_avl falls back to shutil.which (PATH) when ~/bin/avl is absent
rationale: Supports system-wide installs and CI environments without a ~/bin directory

requirement: verify returns the resolved Path for a working AVL binary
rationale: Provides a quick pre-flight check before starting a potentially long sweep

requirement: verify raises RuntimeError containing exited with code for a non-functional binary
rationale: Prevents silent failures from a corrupt or wrong-platform binary masquerading as a valid install

requirement: run passes the command script as input= to the subprocess
rationale: AVL is controlled entirely via stdin; no temporary script files are created

requirement: CLI verify subcommand returns exit code 0 on success and 1 on failure
rationale: Enables health-check scripting and CI pipeline gates

requirement: CLI run subcommand accepts a command file and returns exit code 0 on success
rationale: Exposes low-level AVL access without requiring a Python script

requirement: CLI with no arguments triggers SystemExit (help text)
rationale: First-time users get usage information rather than an unhandled exception

requirement: run invokes avl_runner.run exactly once per call
rationale: All cases are batched into one AVL invocation; multiple calls would spawn redundant processes

requirement: run passes the .avl file's parent directory as cwd
rationale: avl_file and run_file are passed as bare filenames; cwd=avl_dir ensures they resolve and that relative paths inside the .avl (airfoil data) also resolve

requirement: run creates out_dir (including missing parents) before invoking AVL
rationale: Users should not need to manually create output directories

requirement: run deletes existing .st files in out_dir before starting
rationale: Stale files from a previous run would be silently included in the new results

requirement: run raises RuntimeError with the exit code when AVL exits non-zero
rationale: AVL can produce partial output before failing; raising prevents the caller from silently using corrupt results

requirement: run passes avl_file name as a CLI argument to the AVL binary
rationale: Geometry is loaded via CLI arg not LOAD; passing the wrong name causes AVL to silently run a different or missing geometry

requirement: Generated command script contains A A <alpha> for each requested alpha
rationale: Verifies that sweep arguments actually reach the AVL command text

requirement: Default out_dir is <avl_dir>/out/<geometry_name> when not specified
rationale: Provides a predictable output location relative to the geometry file

requirement: out_format=csv writes results.csv to out_dir
rationale: Common interchange format for spreadsheets and downstream tools

requirement: out_format=json writes results.json to out_dir
rationale: Common interchange format for web tools and other language consumers

requirement: out_format=df returns results in memory without writing any file
rationale: Avoids unnecessary disk I/O in programmatic usage

requirement: out_format=<unrecognised> raises ValueError with message containing not recognised
rationale: Fails fast with a clear error rather than silently writing nothing

requirement: avl_fileplot returns a matplotlib Figure
rationale: Caller can embed the figure in notebooks or save to disk

requirement: Figure contains exactly four Axes3D subplots
rationale: Four-view orthographic layout is the standard engineering drawing convention

requirement: All four axes are Axes3D instances
rationale: 2-D axes would silently flatten the geometry and misrepresent dihedral

requirement: Axes carry titles: Isometric, Top, Front, Side
rationale: Labels orient the viewer without consulting documentation

requirement: Figure suptitle contains the geometry header.name
rationale: Distinguishes saved plots when multiple geometries are compared

requirement: At least one line is drawn in the isometric axes
rationale: Missing lines indicate that surface parsing failed or coordinates were not transferred

requirement: CG position is rendered as a scatter collection
rationale: CG visualization is critical for stability interpretation

requirement: Geometry without a body section plots without error
rationale: Wing-only and body-less models are common and must not raise

requirement: With mirroring the isometric axes contains at least 4 lines
rationale: Mirrored surfaces must appear on both sides of the symmetry plane

requirement: aero_filewrite returns an AeroDatabase instance
rationale: Defines the structured output contract for the entire pipeline

requirement: aero_filewrite raises ValueError (message contains empty) for an empty result list
rationale: An empty list is always a caller error; silent NaN-filled tables are harder to diagnose

requirement: AeroDatabase.date is a non-empty string
rationale: Provenance field lets users identify when a table was generated

requirement: Reference quantities (Sref, Cref, Bref, Xref, Yref, Zref) are read from the first result
rationale: Carries reference geometry from the .st file through to the aero database without a separate geometry argument

requirement: A StabTable is created for every name in COEF_NAMES
rationale: All standard 6-DOF coefficients must be queryable even if some were absent from some runs

requirement: A CtrlTable is created for every (coef, surface) pair keyed as <coef>_<d_idx>_<ctrl_name>
rationale: Each control surface independently affects every coefficient; the compound key prevents collisions

requirement: Alpha breakpoints are sorted in ascending order
rationale: Monotonic axes are required by scipy RegularGridInterpolator and MATLAB lookup-table blocks

requirement: Beta breakpoints are sorted in ascending order
rationale: Monotonic axes are required by scipy RegularGridInterpolator and MATLAB lookup-table blocks

requirement: StabTable.data shape is (n_alpha x n_beta)
rationale: Correct shape is required for 2-D table indexing and interpolation

requirement: Only results with all deflections near zero populate StabTable; off-neutral results leave NaN
rationale: Mixing control-deflected results into the neutral aero map corrupts the baseline, per-alpha coefficients

requirement: Off-neutral results do not overwrite StabTable cells
rationale: Ensures the neutral map is uncontaminated even when neutral and deflected runs share the same breakpoint

requirement: CtrlTable.data shape is (n_alpha x n_beta x n_defl)
rationale: Correct shape is required for 3-D lookup table blocks and RegularGridInterpolator

requirement: CtrlTable defl breakpoints are sorted in ascending order
rationale: Monotonic defl axis is required for 3-D interpolation routines

requirement: CtrlTable cell values match source StResult.data values
rationale: Ensures no silent truncation or reordering during pivot from list to 3-D array

requirement: CtrlTable.surface is <d_idx>_<ctrl_name> and CtrlTable.ctrl_name is the surface name
rationale: Metadata fields are used for axis labels and export struct field names

requirement: Geometry with no control surfaces produces an empty ctrl dict
rationale: ctrl must not contain phantom entries for non-existent surfaces

requirement: Geometry with no control surfaces still fills StabTable
rationale: Stability-only models are valid and must produce a complete neutral aero map

requirement: A coefficient absent from a result's .data produces NaN at that table cell
rationale: NaN distinguishes a genuinely missing value from a coefficient that happens to be zero

requirement: aero_fileplot returns a list of matplotlib Figure objects
rationale: Caller iterates and saves or displays each figure individually

requirement: Every item in the returned list is a Figure
rationale: Mixed types would break callers that iterate and call fig.savefig

requirement: The first figure is the stability figure with 6 subplots (one per coefficient)
rationale: Consistent ordering enables programmatic access by index

requirement: Stability figure axes titles include coefficient names (CLtot, CDtot, etc.)
rationale: Labels identify which subplot carries which coefficient without documentation

requirement: If no control surfaces are present exactly one figure is returned
rationale: Single-figure output for geometry-only models must not produce empty control figures

requirement: With one surface and all COEF_NAMES, seven figures are returned (1 stability + 6 control)
rationale: One figure per coefficient for each surface; count must be deterministic

requirement: Each control figure has one subplot per surface
rationale: Combines all surfaces for a given coefficient on one figure for side-by-side comparison

requirement: Each control figure suptitle contains a coefficient name
rationale: Identifies the figure when saved to disk or displayed in a multi-figure viewer

requirement: When beta_ref is not an exact breakpoint the nearest available beta is used
rationale: Exact beta values are rarely available; nearest-neighbor avoids a crash or silent empty plot
